parameters.name: pathId
parameters.description: The process path's identifier — a named station that owns a queue (unit-in → unit-out), e.g. a pick zone or pack line.

parameters.name: cutoffAt
parameters.description: Optional RFC3339 CPT cutoff timestamp. When supplied, the response additionally reports remaining admission capacity for this path correlated against this cutoff, and a `PathCapacityChanged` event is published (ADR-0018).
